# groundstation

> Earth data, agent-ready: an MCP server, web console and scheduled briefings that put the cloud-native geospatial stack (STAC, TiTiler, eoAPI) in the hands of AI agents.

A Development Seed labs prototype. Ask about any place on Earth and it finds fresh satellite imagery, active fires and disaster alerts, weather and smoke, does the pixel math, and returns an interactive map. Every tool that returns a derived number also returns the conditions under which not to trust it.

- [Caveats ADR](https://github.com/dannybauman/groundstation/blob/main/docs/adr-caveats.md): why a number carries its failure conditions
